options.content:
One short sample. Reported data and indicative prices. Not executable and not profit.

Unchanged list rules: lowest turnover above median reported liquidity.
Measured and MinimumFeeOnly are distinct. Depth estimates ignore tick crossings; full mints have a separate column.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id,to_char(to_timestamp((data->>'started_epoch')::bigint),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Start UTC",to_char(to_timestamp((data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "End UTC",data->>'public_requests' AS "API",data->>'rpc_calls' AS "RPC",jsonb_array_length(data->'skipped_tokens') AS "Skipped",jsonb_array_length(data->'capped_tokens') AS "Cap alerts",(SELECT count(*) FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates') AS "Candidates",'Gecko + Dex' AS "Sources",CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(data->'partial_sources')=0 THEN 'None' ELSE 'Partial; see closeout' END AS "Partials" FROM research.pool_map_runs WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1)

WITH q AS (SELECT * FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1)), steps AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('R1',1),('R2',2),('R3',3),('R4',4),('R5',5)) s(step,n)) SELECT step,(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>=n) AS "Entering",(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE data->>'failed_step' IS NULL OR substring(data->>'failed_step',2)::int>n) AS "Leaving",reason AS "Rejection reason",rejected AS "Rejected",(SELECT count(*) FROM q WHERE step='R5' AND data->>'failed_step' IS NULL AND data->>'reason'='Not measured') AS "Fee unknown",'Reported' AS "Evidence" FROM steps LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT data->>'reason' AS reason,count(*) AS rejected FROM q WHERE data->>'failed_step'=step GROUP BY data->>'reason') rejects ON true ORDER BY n,reason

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'price_disagreement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Reported bps",round((data->>'onchain_gap_bps')::numeric,2) AS "OnChain bps",data->>'fee_kind' AS "Fee kind",round((data->>'combined_fee_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Fee bps",round((data->>'bin_step_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Bin step bps",data->>'reason' AS "Review reason",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

panels.title: Candidates — depth estimates and mint checks

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'turnover')::numeric,2) AS "Turnover",round((data->>'sample_movement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Move bps",round((data->>'liquidity_imbalance')::numeric,2) AS "Imbalance",to_char((data->>'deepest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Deepest $ est",data->>'deepest_venue' AS "Deep venue",to_char((data->>'shallowest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Shallow $ est",data->>'shallowest_venue' AS "Shallow venue",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",CASE WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == true)' THEN 'Set' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == null)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Not set' END AS "Freeze flag",CASE WHEN data->>'failed_step'='R4' THEN data->>'reason' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.safe ? (@ == false)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Pass / exemptions' END AS "Mint check",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_clues WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'list'='Candidates' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'price_disagreement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Reported bps",round((data->>'onchain_gap_bps')::numeric,2) AS "OnChain bps",data->>'fee_kind' AS "Fee kind",round((data->>'combined_fee_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Fee bps",round((data->>'bin_step_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Bin step bps",data->>'reason' AS "Review reason",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'control'='true' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

panels.title: Control — depth estimates and mint checks

targets.rawSql: SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",round((data->>'turnover')::numeric,2) AS "Turnover",round((data->>'sample_movement_bps')::numeric,2) AS "Move bps",round((data->>'liquidity_imbalance')::numeric,2) AS "Imbalance",to_char((data->>'deepest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Deepest $ est",data->>'deepest_venue' AS "Deep venue",to_char((data->>'shallowest_depth')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS "Shallow $ est",data->>'shallowest_venue' AS "Shallow venue",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'control'='true' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT data->>'symbol' AS "Pair",CASE WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == true)' THEN 'Set' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.freeze ? (@ == null)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Not set' END AS "Freeze flag",CASE WHEN data->>'failed_step'='R4' THEN data->>'reason' WHEN data->'freeze_flags' @? '$.*.safe ? (@ == false)' THEN 'Not measured' ELSE 'Pass / exemptions' END AS "Mint check",pair_id AS "Full mints" FROM research.pair_requirements WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'control'='true' ORDER BY data->>'symbol'

SELECT (data->>'symbol0')||' / '||(data->>'symbol1') AS "Pair",data->>'venue' AS "Venue",data->>'venue_type' AS "Type",to_timestamp((data->>'created')::bigint) AS "Created",to_char((data->>'liquidity')::numeric,'FM999,999,999,990') AS "Reported $",(data->>'mint0')||' | '||(data->>'mint1') AS "Full mints" FROM research.pool_map_pools WHERE run_id=(SELECT run_id FROM research.pool_map_runs ORDER BY (data->>'finished_epoch')::bigint DESC LIMIT 1) AND data->>'new_pool'='true' ORDER BY pool_id
